summary: Package exfiltrates installer host identifiers to hardcoded VPS on install and import
details: The package's postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, which POSTs installer host data (hostname, install path, cwd, Node version, package name) to the hardcoded endpoint https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc with TLS verification disabled (`rejectUnauthorized: false`). The declared `main` (index.js) additionally calls `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` at top level, so the same beacon fires on any `require()`/`import` of the package. The exported value is a stub Proxy with no real functionality; the package's only effect is to transmit installer identifiers to a bare Contabo VPS subdomain unrelated to any legitimate publisher. The scope name `@c1-ease/autoloan` resembles a financial-services namespace but ships no corresponding code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
